moodgraph

components · 0.2.0 · v4 C1 · aj-c-moodgraph

One week's mood on the Timeline: a monotone curve through the days written, carried in from the last day written before the week and out to the first after, with the ground under it in the colour of the week's average mood (the area rule, README). One day written is a straight line; nothing written is the empty graph. Each point is a button to its day.

Week

This week on the Timeline: the curve, carried in from Saturday 1 August; the ground Even (Even, Low, Low, Good, Even averages 2.8).

Day in view

The day in view (Wednesday 5) ringed --ink.

Point focus

Tab to a point: the product focus ring and the day and mood above it.

Point hover

Hover a point: the ring on the dot and the day and mood above it.

Tie, more days above

Rule demonstration, not the journal: Good, Good, Hard, Light averages 3.5; three days above and one below: Good.

Tie, the latest day

Rule demonstration, not the journal: Good then Even averages 3.5, one day each side; the latest is Even: Even.

One day

One day written: a straight line at its mood across the week (Sunday 14 June, Even).

Empty week

Nothing written this week: the scale and the days, no curve and no ground. This week is always shown.

Long

Stress test only: a long week name and long day names.

Non-Latin

Stress test only: Russian day names, not product copy.
